title: Zingao
wikitext:
Mainly known from being the brain behind Hymn of Hope.

Started playing QW 1997 with friends, played in the 56K modem era, but usually with friends or on a FFA-server. Always been active with spectating or watching QuakeWorld, Quake 3 and Quakelive matches and love everything about eSports.
